sources.note:
Kestrel Robotics: Embedded Firmware Engineer
Preferred first name: Dima (legal name Dmitri Halvorsen).
Phone: 555-0126
I live in Portland, Maine, not Oregon. Recruiters keep mixing that up.
School: Lakeshore Polytechnic Institute, B.S. Electrical Engineering, September 2016 to May 2020.
Two resumes on the laptop: dmitri-halvorsen-general.pdf and dmitri-halvorsen-firmware.pdf.
Skip the voluntary demographic questions.

email.subject: Kestrel Robotics: Embedded Firmware Engineer application
email.body:
Hi Dmitri,

Great speaking with you. As promised, here's the link to apply for the Embedded Firmware Engineer role. The role is fully remote within the United States.

Please attach the firmware-focused resume, dmitri-halvorsen-firmware.pdf, rather than the general one.

If you have questions, I'm at 555-0108.

Ayesha Mendel
Talent Partner, Kestrel Robotics
Boston, Massachusetts
